data.title: Trip details (price, dates, length) are only in an invite-only participant portal

data.detail: Leave trigger: no price, length or dates after three pages. Four pages in (Qué Hacemos > Conexiones Culturales > Involúcrate > Viajes), the only route to trip details is a 'Portal de Viajes' for people already invited, which looks like logging in before seeing details. Lodging (homestays) and destinations (Nicaragua, Dominican Republic) were found, but no cost, length, dates, group size or safety/insurance information. A 'Contáctanos' link exists in the menu, but I have nothing to put in front of my dean.
